title: Orders pipeline · one batch from the Handler to the file

nodes.label: Handler.Submit
nodes.role: Validates, prices and stamps orders, collects them in h.batch and flushes the batch to the Store

nodes.label: FileStore.WriteBatch
nodes.role: Encodes the batch as JSON lines, then appends and syncs it to the file

nodes.label: WriteBatch(orders)
nodes.role: The call where the Handler's batch leaves h.batch and enters FileStore

bubble.html: A full batch of 64 orders, the 2 second tick or Close() calls flushLocked(), which hands the whole h.batch to the Store.
The same []Order slice leaves the Handler and arrives as orders in FileStore.WriteBatch. On error the Handler keeps the batch.
Each order becomes one JSON line in a bytes.Buffer. An order that fails to encode rejects the whole batch before the file is touched.
Under mu, one Write appends the buffer and Sync forces it to disk. Only then does written grow.
